summary: Deterministic gate findings are collapsed and bounded before they become a SlideCritique, so a slide with many defects reaches the repair cycle instead of raising a validation error that ends the deck.
invariants: A critique never carries more issues than SlideCritique.issues accepts.
Identical instructions are emitted once; the gate reports per element and repeats the same sentence for each.
Findings kept beyond the cap follow the gate's own reporting order, and the drop is logged.
A slide within the cap is unchanged, and a slide with no findings still receives no critique.
forbidden: Raise out of the repair-instruction builder: the slide it describes is the one that needs repairing.
Raise the cap on SlideCritique.issues to fit a gate that reports per element.
rationale: Operation b3e18cc2 finished authoring 35 of 35 slides -- the first run to do so -- and then died building the repair instruction for slide 10, whose four overflowing boxes produced 12 gate issues against a cap of 8.
Four identical sentences are not four instructions: collapsing them took that slide from 12 issues to 6 and made the cap irrelevant for it.
The same bounding already existed at authored_quality_review_support; this closes the one builder that lacked it.
